scripts.build: bun run build:clean && bun run build:extension
scripts.build:extension: bun build src/content.tsx --outdir dist --target browser --minify && bun build src/popup.tsx --outdir dist --target browser --minify && bun build src/background.ts --outdir dist --target browser --minify && bunx tailwindcss -i src/popup.css -o dist/popup.css --minify && cp src/content.css dist/ && cp src/manifest.json dist/ && cp -r public/* dist/ 2>/dev/null || true
scripts.dev: bun run build:extension && bun run dev:watch
scripts.dev:watch: bun build src/content.tsx src/popup.tsx src/background.ts --outdir dist --target browser --watch & bunx tailwindcss -i src/popup.css -o dist/popup.css --watch & cp src/content.css dist/ && cp -r public/* dist/ 2>/dev/null || true
